en.headline: Legislative Council uses AI for first time to analyse five-year plan debate
en.dek: President Starry Lee said the tool processed about 450,000 words of remarks from 88 lawmakers, with livelihood protection taking nearly 30 per cent of coverage.
body: Legislative Council President Starry Lee Wai-king said the Secretariat had for the first time used artificial intelligence to produce an overview of the three-day combined debate on the city’s first five-year plan and the 2026 Policy Address.

Eighty-eight lawmakers spoke a total of 214 times for more than 26 hours, generating a verbatim record of about 450,000 words. Among the six sessions, the one on improving livelihood protection drew the largest number of speakers and accounted for nearly 30 per cent of the total coverage.

Lee said the overview, which identified talent and the Northern Metropolis as the most frequently discussed themes, would be circulated to lawmakers and submitted to the government to help authorities grasp the key focus areas of the debate.

zh.headline: 立法會首次以人工智能分析五年規劃及施政報告辯論發言
zh.dek: 李慧琼指秘書處分析約45萬字逐字紀錄，完善民生保障環節佔整體篇幅近三成，人才及北部都會區最受關注。
body: 立法會主席李慧琼表示，立法會秘書處首次運用人工智能，分析上星期一連三日就《香港第一個五年規劃》及本年度《施政報告》合併辯論的議員發言，並製備概覽。
共有88名議員發言214次，總發言時間超過26小時，逐字紀錄約45萬字。在六個環節中，完善民生保障的環節有最多議員發言，佔整體發言篇幅近三成。
李慧琼說，概覽顯示人才及北部都會區是最受關注的範疇，有關概覽將供議員參閱並提交政府參考，以便當局精準掌握辯論重點。
